terms.title: Bottle Storage and Collection Terms
terms.item1: The storage period is {days} days. Please check your deposit record for the expiry date and final collection deadline.
terms.item2: Withdrawals for in-store consumption are unavailable every {blocked}. Take-home collection remains available on these days, provided your collection entitlement has not expired.
terms.item3: Collection is allowed until 4:00 a.m. on the day after the expiry date. This covers the early hours following the final eligible night. It does not include the evening opening on that date.
terms.item4: If the expiry date falls on a restricted day, the final eligible day moves to the next unrestricted day, and your collection entitlement ends at 4:00 a.m. the day after.
terms.item5: You must collect your bottle before the final deadline. Submitting a request before the deadline does not extend the storage period or reserve the right to collect your bottle later.
terms.item6: Once the final collection deadline has passed, the venue reserves the right not to return the stored bottle. No refunds or compensation for its value will be provided under any circumstances.
terms.accept: I have read, understood, and agree to the terms above, including the restricted days, final collection deadline, and the no-return and no-refund conditions after the deadline.
terms.error: Please read and accept the Bottle Storage and Collection Terms before submitting.
